DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT

1. ESTABLISHMENT OF DISTRIBUTORSHIP

1.1 Grant and Acceptance. The Company hereby grants to the Distributor, and the Distributor hereby accepts, the exclusive right to distribute the Products in the Territory during the term of this Agreement.

The Distributor shall use its best efforts to promote the sale of the Products throughout the Territory.

1.2 License. The Company grants to the Distributor a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Company's trademarks solely in connection with the marketing and sale of the Products.

1.6 Minimum Purchases. The Distributor shall satisfy each of the following minimum requirements during each contract year:

(A) Purchase not less than the minimum quantity set forth in Exhibit B;
(B) Submit quarterly forecasts to the Company;
(C) Maintain adequate inventory levels at all times.

Failure to satisfy the foregoing minimum purchase requirements shall entitle the Company to terminate the exclusivity granted under Section 1.1.

2. TERM

This Agreement shall remain in effect for an initial term of five years, commencing on the Effective Date.

CONFIDENTIALITY

Each party agrees to hold the other party's confidential information in strict confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.

3. TERMINATION

Either party may terminate this Agreement upon sixty days written notice to the other party in the event of a material breach that remains uncured.
